hooks.text: 防线一旦崩溃，塔防会立刻转成由玩家亲自躲弹求生的动作局面。
hooks.excerpt: In this action Tower Defense game, you fend off hordes of skeletons by strategically placing sea creature turrets. Beware that as your line of defense falls, this quickly turns into a game of survival where you dodge around for dear life!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 机械海洋生物就是炮塔库，手枪虾、海军海豹与死亡射线需要逐个解锁并摸索用途。
hooks.excerpt: Your arsenal is filled with mechanized sea lives! Those cool inventions (such as Pistol Shrimp, Navy Seal, and Death Ray) will handle the fight. You’ll discover new turret types one after another - Figure out how best to utilize each of ‘em!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 敌人掉落的药剂能把同一炮塔改造成冰冻、变异或潜行等不同形态。
hooks.excerpt: Skeletons will sometimes drop a variety of Elixirs. Use them to boost turrets into different forms! Will you turn a turret into a frosty ice machine, a powerful mutant, or a shadowy stealth weapon?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
